content.title: Here's how to buy Sweet 16 March Madness tickets for every game
content.text: March 20, 2026Updated March 25, 2026, 2:08 p.m. ETThe 2026 March Madness Sweet 16 will take place in San Jose, Houston, Chicago, and Washington, D.C.Each regional site will host two Sweet 16 games and one Elite 8 game.An all-session pass is available for each of the four regional sites, permitting access to all three games in one location.We're on to the Sweet 16! How's your bracket going? Mine pretty much died on the first day. The first weekend of March Madness saw a lot of chalk, but also some thrilling upsets and high-quality basketball.The Sweet 16 is set and it's time to grab last-minute tickets for one of the four regional sites: San Jose, California, Houston, Texas, Chicago, Illinois and Washington, D.C. Each site will host three games, including two Sweet 16 games and one Elite 8 game. We now know the matchups for each region, and all-session passes are already available for all four sites.Here is everything you need to know to buy March Madness Sweet 16 tickets for all four regions:Buy March Madness Sweet 16 ticketsMarch Madness Sweet 16 ticketsSee all available tickets for the Sweet 16 rounds in four regional locations: San Jose, Calif., Chicago, Ill., Washington D.C. and Houston, Texas. Get Sweet 16 tickets nowWho is playing in the Sweet 16?The second round wrapped up Sunday, March 22. March Madness Sweet 16 ticketsTickets for Sweet 16 March Madness games in Washington D.C. are already available. Tickets are currently available as an all sessions pass, or you can choose between session passes. An all-access pass gets you the same seat for all three games.
